results.title: Secret of Kalinga
results.overview: A college sits on ancient Kalinga kingdom land. Behind it, a forest well holds a princess's spirit, imprisoned centuries ago. Students accidentally break the seal on New Year's Eve, triggering comedic chaos.

results.title: Artemis II – Zurück zum Mond
results.overview: For the first time since the legendary Apollo missions over 50 years ago, humans are once again setting out for the Moon on April 1, 2026. NASA’s Artemis II mission marks the beginning of a new era in space exploration, and Germany will play a key role. This documentary follows the four astronauts during their preparations and offers exclusive insights into the Orion spacecraft. German astronauts Alexander Gerst and Matthias Maurer, along with other space experts, explain how the mission will proceed and why it is being undertaken. It's a journey that blends science, adventure, and the fundamental question: Why do people risk their lives to reach other celestial bodies and distant worlds?

results.title: Max vs 100
results.overview: Follows Four-time Formula 1 World Champion Max Verstappen who will take on 100 drivers in a unique go-karting event competition.

results.title: Augè
results.overview: A reflection dances on the walls of a place suspended between magic and history. A short film about Grosio Castle, inspired by Calvino’s *Cosmicomics*.

results.title: Dear Family
results.overview: Dear Family is a family-centered Bangladeshi Eid natok that explores the emotional dynamics, misunderstandings, and hidden bonds within a modern household. The story typically revolves around generational gaps, unspoken expectations, and the struggle to maintain unity in a changing social context.

results.title: Beloved
results.overview: Asle and Gerd met in a small coastal village far west towards the sea. They have a son, and for a time their happiness is perfect. But Asle, the sailor, is restless and is drawn to the sea, while Gerd is left in the village, alone with the child. The distance between them folds, and the question is asked: How much distance can love tolerate?

results.title: The Kerala Story 2
results.overview: Three young Indian women across different states choose love over tradition, only to become trapped. Their parallel lives show how romance and rebellion transform into control and silence, turning love into a weapon that destroys freedom.

results.title: Norm: The Tale of Norm Macdonald
results.original_title: Norm: The Tale of Norm Macdonald
results.overview: Go down a wormhole in this documentary on master of deadpan humor Norm Macdonald, whose life and career were uncompromising yet full of contradictions.

results.title: Flowers
results.overview: After a magical encounter with a flower, Moisés and his child Samy embark on a journey of discovery and transformation. Through an ancient tale and Samy’s perspective, a world full of colors begins to unfold, where other ways of existing start to reveal themselves.

results.title: Proshnouttor
results.overview: The movie "Prashnottar" (released in 2026) is a gripping social thriller that delves into the complexities of modern relationships and the search for truth.

results.title: Only Bears
results.overview: Over the course of one wildly unpredictable day, two married bears attempt to rekindle their intimacy—but between traffic, screenings, queer social chaos, and a stranger handing them gently used pizza, life keeps acting like the pushy “third” in their relationship

results.title: American Dollhouse
results.overview: Caught between a grotesque Christmas fantasy and her own childhood trauma, a woman's search for a fresh start in her hometown is violently interrupted by a psychopathic neighbor.

results.title: Prakambanam
results.overview: A group of students' lives are thrown into chaos after one of them is possessed by the spirit of an elderly woman.

results.title: Prem Keetanu
results.overview: A group of young men and their turbulent college life, where bad grades and hopelessness remain in the driver's seat. Even as they pursue love, friendship and aspirations, the film promises to capture the current generation's struggles and dreams in a light-hearted yet heartfelt manner.

results.title: K3 Superhelden
results.overview: Hanne, Marthe en Julia get a special visit when Superhero Vonk shows up at their door with three superhero suits for them. K3 turns into superheroes, but soon they find out that there is a dark side to it...

results.title: The Swimmers
results.overview: It’s the 368th day of summer, night hasn’t come for three days. A group of friends spends the hottest summer in history out on the streets, amid power outages and a massive exodus abroad. Driven mad by the heat, they decide to sneak into the mansions of an empty neighborhood to try out every swimming pool they can find. But the heat is an infernal threat.

results.title: Magick Mtn.
results.overview: Lord Mmorke, a tepid and ghoulish narrator, walks us through 3 separate fables all intersecting in a realm beyond the tangible. Rituals and retellings about a Deathrock squatter jailed by a sadistic psychiatrist and the evils of regret, a pair of criminal plumbers plunging further towards Hell's grips and the beer-soaked leather of the Sunset Strip, and an architect's ambition built on the shaky bedrock of the Devil's promise. What begins as a tale ends in a spell cast upon unsuspecting characters and audiences alike

results.title: Easy Girl
results.overview: Spending every evening in a new and mysterious stranger’s bed, capricious transient Nore agrees to move into a spare room eagerly offered to her by Jonna, a reserved medical student. Against the odds, this unlikely pair finds solace in each other and fall into an intoxicating pattern of partying hard at night with the local men vying for their attention. As their relationship intensifies, Nore’s troubled past comes to light and threatens to dismantle the blissfully ignorant, inexplicably jubilant lifestyle they’ve built together.
